title: schc_session_rx: bool/uint8 semantic overload of INVALID_COORD as caller-error verdict
description: Review finding (minor, pass 1 finding 3, l1qw.3.7.6.4): lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/schc_session_rx.c returns LICHEN_SCHC_RX_INVALID_COORD for non-coordinate caller contract violations (NULL/closed session, NULL tile, tile_len==0, tile_len>179) as well as genuine wire-coordinate problems (W>1, FCN>62). The header doc was updated to cover both, but a caller still cannot distinguish 'malformed wire coordinate' from 'programming error'. Consider a dedicated LICHEN_SCHC_RX_INVALID_ARG verdict if the distinction ever matters to the slice-5 integration seam. P3 polish; not blocking.
